description: This file defines the LeaveEntitlementService class within the OrangeHRM Leave plugin. It manages leave entitlement logic such as retrieving balances, adding entitlements, and handling leave periods with dependency injection, strategy pattern, and DAO interactions.

classes.name: LeaveEntitlementService
classes.description: Service class responsible for managing employee leave entitlements, including retrieval, addition, deletion, and balance calculations, with configurable strategies and DAO interactions.

methods.name: getLeaveEntitlementStrategy
methods.description: Retrieves the current leave entitlement consumption strategy, instantiating it if necessary.

methods.name: getLeaveEntitlementDao
methods.description: Provides access to the DAO responsible for leave entitlement database operations.

methods.name: getDeletableIdsFromEntitlementIds
methods.description: Filters a list of entitlement IDs, returning only those that are eligible for deletion.

methods.name: isDeletable
methods.description: Determines if a given entitlement can be deleted (i.e., no days have been used).

methods.name: getLeaveBalance
methods.description: Calculates and returns the leave balance for an employee and leave type at a specific date or period.

methods.name: addEntitlementForEmployee
methods.description: Adds or updates a leave entitlement record for an employee within a given date range.

methods.name: bulkAssignLeaveEntitlements
methods.description: Assigns leave entitlements to multiple employees in bulk.
